seven_over_ten.note: slash drawn straight up: read whole it was 7110

eight_over_ten_speck.note: a speck by the 10 read 109; the page was graded 1 off a tick lower down

decimal_over_ten.note: 7.5 over an upright slash came back 7.75

leaning_decimal_over_ten.note: a leaning slash, which the old rule already split

four_over_ten.note: 4 over 10: the upright of the 4 must not be the slash

four_upright_longer.note: split on the upright of the 4, the slash read as the 1 of a 10 and the grade came back 6

one_with_flag.note: a 1 whose flag is a stroke of its own reads 11: over the maximum under a /10

diagonal_seven_over_eight.note: a diagonal fraction: the slash is half the height of the mark, read 8 before

diagonal_comma_over_eight.note: 4,5 on a diagonal over 8, read 8 before

zero_over_five_crossing.note: the top stroke of the 5 lies across the slash line: 0/5 read 01 over 5

lost_point_over_five.note: 0.5/5 with no point stroke read 05, full marks

circle_with_a_tail.note: the tail of the circle leaves its box: the ring stayed a glyph and 2.5 read as a confident 0

touching_seven_five.note: the foot of the 7 runs into the 5: one blob, 5.75 read 5.5

touching_one_zero.note: the 1 and the 0 of the 10 touch: the denominator read 0

short_slash_big_six.note: the 6 is 1.27 times the slash: 2/6 read 6

diagonal_five_over_eight.note: slash box smaller than the 8 though its length is not: 5/8 read 8

short_diagonal_comma.note: the slash of 5,5/8 is under 0.4 of the mark: read 3

crossed_seven.note: the cross of the 7 must not become a digit of its own

leaning_four_stem.note: the stem of the 4 leans: cut apart, 4,5/8 read 1.5

point_seven_five_over_five.note: 0.75/5 came back 0.97: the 7 was read as a 1 and taken for a slash
